Short Description: mesoView provides a rapid, slide-free, tissue-to-digital pathology solution for intraoperative assessment. Our goal is to enhance the efficiency and performance of cancer surgery, not only by reducing delays but also by minimizing the risk of secondary surgery for cancer patients.
Long Description: Our team has developed the globally leading mesoscale Nonlinear Optical Gigascope (mNLOG) platform, enabling unprecedented imaging capabilities with 250 nm digital resolution (Digital Pathological WSI-compliant), a 9× larger field of view, and 4.5× faster sampling compared to traditional confocal systems. Leveraging this core technology, PATHOscope redefines digital pathology by offering a virtual optical sectioning, high-resolution imaging solution that streamlines workflows and reduces diagnostic turnaround times. Unlike conventional approaches, PATHOscope delivers exceptional performance while remaining fully compatible with gold-standard H&E staining protocols. This makes it the only advanced imaging system capable of real-time, intraoperative cancer assessment without the need for tissue freezing or sectioning—setting a new benchmark for pathology efficiency and accuracy.
